domain_context: Auction Marketplace exclusively for BC Residents

color_palette.description: High-contrast Swiss color palette emphasizing strict Black and White structure with urgent, authoritative Red accents.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy. Generous spacing. Optical alignment. Sharp corners and high contrast.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Go cardless where possible. Flat rectangular solid backgrounds. 1px solid borders. No drop shadows. Use grid lines to separate data.

components.buttons: Square edges, high contrast. Primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90. Secondary: bg-secondary text-white hover:bg-secondary/90.
components.inputs: Shadcn input with rounded-none, border-input focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary
components.auction_cards: Flat borders, hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Large image area. Prominent countdown timer in primary red.
components.navigation: Solid background, sticky top, z-50, 1px bottom border. Include Canadian maple leaf logo reference.
components.badges: Square edges. For BC verified: bg-secondary text-white. For Live Auction: bg-primary text-white animate-pulse.

motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Animations convey urgency (flashing red for ending soon) and state changes.

hero_background.description: Abstract geometric red and black pattern, architectural geometry
hero_background.usage: Full-bleed background for hero section with a dark overlay to ensure text contrast.

featured_product.description: Luxury watch on black reflective surface with red ambient glow
featured_product.usage: Featured high-value auction item placeholder on home page.

vancouver_skyline.description: Vancouver skyline with buildings and water
vancouver_skyline.usage: Background for 'Local BC Residents Only' section, Verification page, or About page.

auction_gavel.usage: Thumbnail for 'How it Works' or placeholder for administrative/legal sections.

bc_nature.description: Scenic view of lush green forests and mountains
bc_nature.usage: Category placeholder for 'Outdoors & Recreation' or local listings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Clash Display' and 'IBM Plex Sans' fonts via Google Fonts or Fontshare in the HTML head.
Use '@phosphor-icons/react' for all iconography to match the technical, high-contrast aesthetic.
Apply the '--radius: 0rem' rule strictly across Shadcn components to enforce the Swiss architectural look.
Ensure all buttons, interactive elements, and forms have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='place-bid-button').
Bidding countdowns MUST use tabular-nums utility so numbers don't shift horizontally during countdowns.
Implement bento grid layouts for the featured auctions layout, intentionally spanning different columns for asymmetry (e.g., col-span-4 vs col-span-2).
The Hero Section Image must have an overlay of bg-black/60 or bg-white/70 to ensure text contrast (APCA compliant).
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for marketing and landing pages to allow free-form layouts. Use heavily customized Shadcn UI only for functional blocks (forms, dashboard tables, modals).
Do NOT use placeholder text or empty URLs for images; map the provided media URLs specifically to their intended sections.
